title: Model Whitehead with prescribed good cylinders
statement: Use model-category conventions of [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category and let $X,Y$ be cofibrant fibrant objects. A good cylinder for an object $A$ consists of maps $i_0,i_1:A\to C_A$ and $p:C_A\to A$ such that $pi_0=pi_1=1_A$, $p$ is a weak equivalence, and $(i_0,i_1):A\amalg A\to C_A$ is a cofibration. Given any specified good cylinders $C_X,C_Y$ and any weak equivalence $f:X\to Y$, there are $g:Y\to X$, $H_X:C_X\to X$, and $H_Y:C_Y\to Y$ with $H_Xi_0=gf$, $H_Xi_1=1_X$, $H_Yi_0=fg$, and $H_Yi_1=1_Y$.
